steps.code: <?php require 'wordpress/wp-load.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php'; function mono_create_placeholder($w, $h, $name) { $img = imagecreatetruecolor($w, $h); $grey = imagecolorallocate($img, rand(40,80), rand(40,80), rand(40,80)); imagefill($img, 0, 0, $grey); for($i=0; $i<8; $i++) { $c = imagecolorallocate($img, rand(20,120), rand(20,120), rand(20,120)); imagefilledrectangle($img, rand(0,$w), rand(0,$h), rand(0,$w), rand(0,$h), $c); } $upload = wp_upload_dir(); $path = $upload['path'].'/'.$name; imagejpeg($img, $path, 90); imagedestroy($img); $attach_id = wp_insert_attachment(array('post_mime_type'=>'image/jpeg','post_title'=>sanitize_file_name($name),'post_status'=>'inherit'), $path); $meta = wp_generate_attachment_metadata($attach_id, $path); wp_update_attachment_metadata($attach_id, $meta); return $attach_id; } $a1 = mono_create_placeholder(1600,1000,'vienna-street.jpg'); $p1 = wp_insert_post(array('post_title'=>'Shadows on Karlsplatz','post_content'=>'Walking through Vienna in the early morning, the shadows told stories that words could not capture.','post_status'=>'publish','meta_input'=>array('monochrome_location'=>'Vienna'))); set_post_thumbnail($p1,$a1); update_option('sticky_posts',array($p1)); $a2 = mono_create_placeholder(800,1000,'morning-light.jpg'); $p2 = wp_insert_post(array('post_title'=>'Morning Light','post_content'=>'The first light of day reveals what darkness hides.','post_status'=>'publish','meta_input'=>array('monochrome_location'=>'Prague'))); set_post_thumbnail($p2,$a2); $a3 = mono_create_placeholder(800,600,'urban-geometry.jpg'); $p3 = wp_insert_post(array('post_title'=>'Urban Geometry','post_content'=>'Lines and angles shape the city into an abstract composition.','post_status'=>'publish','meta_input'=>array('monochrome_location'=>'Berlin'))); set_post_thumbnail($p3,$a3); $a4 = mono_create_placeholder(900,700,'late-afternoon.jpg'); $p4 = wp_insert_post(array('post_title'=>'Late Afternoon','post_content'=>'The golden hour casts long shadows across the pavement.','post_status'=>'publish','meta_input'=>array('monochrome_location'=>'Munich'))); set_post_thumbnail($p4,$a4); ?>
